## History

Rudge was a married individual who passed away, leading his widow, Mrs. Rudge, to dissolve their household. During his lifetime, he and his wife became parents when she gave birth to multiple children at once.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Nell’s History P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P32](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0032)_
